scope: All 531 directed graphs through 3 distinct content definitions, plus explicit schema/kind/reference/data boundary cases. Shared cenc transport; independent semantic checks and transitive-closure cycle algorithm.

mutations.name: admit-dangling-content-reference
mutations.extraTo: for (const reference of byId.get(key)!.referencedContentIds) if (byId.has(canonicalKey(reference))) visit(canonicalKey(reference));

supersededMutationAttempts.name: skip-content-reference-existence
supersededMutationAttempts.reason: Removing only the explicit existence check still rejects during DFS traversal of the missing node. Replaced with a two-site dangling-reference acceptance mutant; no claim that the first mutation was killed.
